n, k = map(int, input().split())
digits = []

while n > 0:
    digits.append(n % k)
    n //= k

total_shift = sum(digits)
result_value = 0

for i in range(len(digits)):
    total_shift -= digits[i]
    for j in range(digits[i] - 1, -1, -1):
        result_value = (result_value * k + (total_shift + j) % k)

print(result_value % 1000000007)
